spans.s:
(ञ) ष्टुञ् r. 2nd cl. (स्तौति or स्तुते स्तवीति or स्तवीते)
1 To praise, to eulogise.
2 To hymn, to worship with praises.

r. 1st cl. (स्तोचते)
To be clear, to be bright, to be pellucid.

r. 10th cl. (स्तूपयति)
To heap together, to pile up, to collect into a heap; also स्तूप.

(उ) ष्टुभु r. 1st cl. (स्तोभति)
1 To stop, to hinder.
2 To be stupid or dull.
